Jim Burney, aged 24, was out of work and out of money and all alone in New York over Christmas.
He decided to kill himself by jumping off the Empire State Building.
He took the lift to the top floor, the 86th, where he held on to the safety fence for a moment.
He said a quick prayer, then threw himself off and fell towards the hundreds of cars moving along Fifth Avenue, over 1,000 feet below.
When he woke up half an hour later he found himself on a narrow ledge on the 85th floor, outside the offices of a television station, where the strong wind had blown him.
The young man was so relieved that he decided to give up the idea of committing suicide.
Jim Burney himself not only survived.
He had a great Christmas - he got a lot of invitations to Christmas dinner!
